accuracy.evidence: Counting back as a subtraction strategy matches NC 2013 Year 1 (subtract one-digit numbers within 20, related subtraction facts), Development Matters 2021 Reception ('one less than') and NCETM Mastering Number. Every sum checked by hand: 7 − 3 = 4 (6, 5, 4), 9 − 2 = 7 (8, 7), stories 10 − 2 = 8 and 6 − 3 = 3, box 8 − 3 = 5 (7, 6, 5), robot 8 − 3 'So 6' is wrong (5), 6 − 2 = 4 right, 9 − 1 'So 10' wrong (8), 5 − 3 = 2 right; checks 6 + 3 lands on 9 (right), 6 + 2 lands on 8 not 7 (wrong), 8 + 3 lands on 11 not 10 (wrong). Parameterised answers a-b and a-1 stay 3 to 9 at every corner.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets the documented count-back errors (Fuson 1992; Carpenter and Moser 1984): saying the start number as the first count (hop predict, 'Stay on 7' button feedback, robot 8 − 3, check scene wrong claims, p3, m2, m3, challenge 'start'), counting on instead of back (forward-tap feedback, robot 9 − 1, m5, challenge 'on'), starting on the part taken away (story predict and 'Start on 2' feedback, p4, m4, challenge 'part'), recounting from 1 (box predict, m8, challenge 'one'), and checking by counting back again (p5, challenge 'checkback').

lab_distinct.evidence: flagcountback is about the count-back step itself: each tap on the track must land exactly one box lower, the start box is refused as a hop with its own message, story sums make the child choose the whole before hopping, cakes leave a box whose lid never opens, a robot speaks its count-back aloud with the start-number slip, and a forward hop check undoes the subtraction. It differs from flagcounton (counting on from a hidden jar and bus) and flagzero (empty set) in mechanism, and the lab_distinct gate measures it under 30% against every lab.

lab_teaches.evidence: The child finds the rule by doing: the track accepts only the box one lower, so the hop count and the numbers said line up; tapping the start box again gives 'Saying 7 is not a hop'. Arcs numbered 1, 2, 3 above the track show one hop per thing taken. The check scene lets the child see that the two start-number slips land one short of the whole. Done messages state the rule only after the task.

predictions.evidence: Four predictions with tempting wrong options the lab disproves: 'Yes: 7, 6, 5' (the track will not count the start box as a hop and lands on 4), 'On 2, the birds that fly' (tapping 2 is refused with the whole explained), 'Yes, open it and count from 1' (the box never opens and the count-back still gives 5), and 'On 7, so Sam is right' (counting on 2 from 6 lands on 8).

challenge_feedback.evidence: Six challenge questions, each wrong option tagged with a slip and its own message: start ('Do not say the start number as a count. The first hop back lands on 1 less.'), on, part, one and checkback. In the lab, wrong taps also name the slip: start box, wrong direction, skipped box, the number taken away chosen as the start, and 'that is how many were in before' on the box keys.

readability.evidence: Kid paragraphs use short sentences, numbers to 10 and one idea each (start on the big number, one number per hop, the start-number trap, checking by counting on); validate_lessons readability passes for kid and adult text. Lab banners stay under about 10 words, e.g. 'Start on 9. Tap where the first hop lands.'

no_filler.evidence: Every kid sentence is a step, an example or a warning; adult paragraphs give curriculum placement and key words, how to set up a number track, the common mistakes, and what the lab scenes do. No filler phrases (content gate passes) and no repeated template wording across scenes.

mobile.evidence: Checked 360 px screenshots in light and dark for every scene after Show me: banners fit on one line, the 10-box track has boxes about 30 px wide with 17 px numbers, the 12-box check track stays readable, the box scene keys are about 60 px, and Right and Slip are wide tiles. Every scene also has large labelled buttons under the canvas.

accessibility.evidence: Every canvas action has a labelled button twin: Hop back one (with the target number), Stay on 7, Hop forward, Start on 10 or 2, Take a cake out with number keys 4-8, Right and Slip, Hop forward one. The canvas aria-label is updated with every message, the challenge feedback is a polite live region, and the walk gate's axe run is clean in both themes.
